request.system: Assess whether the hypothesis or expression uses or tests numbered claims. Return JSON only: {"uses_claim": true|false, "claim_ids": []}. Return one bare JSON object without Markdown fences or commentary. uses_claim must be a JSON boolean. claim_ids must be an array of integer claim numbers, never quoted strings; use an empty array when uses_claim is false.
request.prompt: {"claims": {"1": "**Summary of findings**", "2": "Both interaction features failed.", "3": "Combining three-month hourly pay growth with the three-month change in average hours gave a slightly negative, insignificant information coefficient (about minus 0.02, t near minus 1.1).", "4": "It was identical in low and high T regimes, so this pairing looks uninformative.", "5": "Pairing V06's standardized stock level with rising V02 flows was also negative overall (about minus 0.05, t near minus 1.4).", "6": "Its sixty-month window cut coverage to roughly half.", "7": "However, its sign flipped by regime: negative when T was low and clearly positive when T was high.", "8": "Next steps: condition on T, use expanding windows to restore coverage, and test sign reversal."}, "hypothesis": "Six-month log hourly-pay growth that is unusually high versus each group's trailing three-year history captures fresher demand tightening than twelve-month growth, predicting higher next-month relative returns.", "expression": "csrank(tsz(lchg(V05,6),36))"}
